genuineStructuralCorroboration.reader: Supplied pyavb use_ext=False; secondary structural corroboration only

supportedRules: Only actual used FILL intervals activate their containing track proxy; do not unconditionally traverse every stored filler_proxy or discard every proxy.
Relative tracks use contextual structural ownership, not a global guessed parent and not MobId or A1/V1 labels. Carry each ownership occurrence independently.

scope0 means nearest enclosing scope, scope1 the next. Scope membership follows native IsScope overrides; ordinary group true, Sequence false, TimeWarp false, PanVolume false, inspected EQ/AudioSuite true.
TrackRef adds relative_track to the containing track array slot, checks bounds and may walk farther out for nonzero relative_scope, then requires matching kind and exact edit rate.
Scope traversal sums established Sequence full-segment starts and0 for ordinary TrackGroup frames; the resolved offset shifts both endpoints.
A source-Mob jump follows target composition ownership from its own root; it does not make the caller SourceClip a parent.
GetIsolation is runtime state defaulting to0 in inspected constructors; no encoded AVB property was established. Do not equate mc_mode or mob_type with isolation without additional evidence.
Maintain existing cancellation/cycle guards; native parent/Resolve loops inspected here have no explicit malformed-graph cycle limit.

implementationOptions.option: Carry ownership frames during each excerpt traversal
implementationOptions.pros: Matches native contextual parent/slot/offset semantics and preserves separate uses/shared nodes; allows FILL activation exactly where used.
implementationOptions.cons: Requires contextual visit/cycle state and careful reset on Mob reference jumps; more code and authored tests.

implementationOptions.option: Prepare a temporary qualified parent lookup and resolve uniquely owned routes first
implementationOptions.pros: Can support a smaller initial subset and reuse existing object lookup.
implementationOptions.cons: Shared/multiple ownership remains unresolved unless lookup stores contextual paths; risks reintroducing more machinery later. Must not choose an arbitrary parent or traverse all candidates.

policyNotes: Existing C29 inclusion of placed muted/disabled components remains independent of native proxy lookup choosing another proxy when target track is disabled; do not prune those placed original branches.
Ambiguous/unsupported scope, ownership, timing, kinds, rates or cycles follow already selected proven-only behavior with Console gaps.
Independent bins, separate excerpts, clip-local counts and length recalculation are already decided and are not reopened here.
